    if [[ "$date_str" == *"/"* ]]; then
        # Convert DD/MM/YYYY to ISO format
        IFS='/' read -r day month year <<< "$date_str"
        echo "${year}-${month}-${day}T12:00:00Z"
    else
        # Already in ISO format or similar
        echo "$date_str"
    fi
}

# Function to clean value field (convert nulls to 0)
clean_value() {
    local value="$1"
    if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" == "null" || "$value" == "N/A" || "$value" == "n/a" ]]; then
        echo "0"
    else
        echo "$value"
    fi
}

echo "Starting CSV data loading..."

total_loaded=0

for file in "$CSV_DIR"/*.csv; do
    if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
        echo
        echo "Processing $(basename "$file")..."

        # Read file line by line, skip headers and clean data
        header_found=false
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            # Remove trailing commas and trim whitespace
            clean_line=$(echo "$line" | sed 's/,*$//' | xargs)

            # Skip empty lines
            if [[ -z "$clean_line" ]]; then
                continue
            fi

            # Check if this is a header line
            if [[ "$clean_line" == *"event_id,event_ts,user_id,event_type,value"* ]]; then
                header_found=true
                continue
            fi

            # Skip lines before header is found
            if [[ "$header_found" == false ]]; then
                continue
            fi

            # Parse CSV line
            IFS=',' read -r event_id event_ts user_id event_type value <<< "$clean_line"

            # Skip invalid lines
            if [[ -z "$event_id" || -z "$event_ts" || -z "$user_id" || -z "$event_type" ]]; then
                echo "Skipping invalid line: $clean_line"
                continue
            fi

            # Clean the data
            event_id=$(echo "$event_id" | xargs)
            event_ts=$(convert_date "$(echo "$event_ts" | xargs)")
            user_id=$(echo "$user_id" | xargs)
            event_type=$(echo "$event_type" | xargs)
            value=$(clean_value "$(echo "$value" | xargs)")

            # Create JSON payload
            json_payload="{\"event_id\":\"$event_id\",\"event_ts\":\"$event_ts\",\"user_id\":\"$user_id\",\"event_type\":\"$event_type\",\"value\":$value}"

            # Send to Moose
            response=$(curl -s -X POST "$INGEST_URL" \
                -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                -d "$json_payload" \
                -w "%{http_code}")

            if [[ "$response" == *"SUCCESS200" ]]; then
                echo "✓ Loaded event: $event_id"
                ((total_loaded++))
            else
                echo "✗ Failed to load event $event_id: $response"
            fi

        done < "$file"
    fi
done

echo
echo "🎉 Successfully loaded $total_loaded events total!"
